🧠 FAQ – ReGym Help Center

🔐 Account & Security

Q: How do I reset my password?
A: Go to the Login page, click "Forgot Password," and follow the instructions sent to your email.

Q: Can I change my username or email?
A: Yes, go to the Edit Profile page to update your info.

🛍 Buying & Orders

Q: How do I place an order?
A: Click “Buy” on a listing, add to your cart, then proceed to Checkout.

Q: Where can I track my order?
A: Visit My Orders to see your order status and delivery info.

Q: Can I cancel an order?
A: Orders can only be canceled before they are marked as shipped. Visit My Orders and click "Cancel" if available.

💸 Selling & Listings

Q: How do I list an item?
A: Go to Create Listing, fill out the form, and click “Submit.”

Q: What happens when my item is sold?
A: You’ll get a notification, and the item will move to your My Sales page.

Q: How do I get paid?
A: Earnings from sales are shown in your Dashboard under “Total Earnings.” You can request a payout once it’s available.

💬 Support & Policies

Q: How do I contact support?
A: Use the Help & Support section or email us at support@regym.com.

Q: What is the return policy?
A: Buyers have 7 days to request a return if the item is not as described. Sellers must respond within 48 hours.
